passages.text: About Us Your browser does not support the video tag. Siete is a Mexican-American food brand, rooted in family, that creates delicious heritage-inspired foods with thoughtfully selected ingredients. Our Mission Boldly build the leading Mexican-American food brand. Embody a Juntos es Mejor culture: value humility, foster diversity, love people always. Positively impact the lives of underserved communities through education, entrepreneurship, and wellness. Operate with a "Family first, family second, business third" attitude.

Our Pillars of Innovation Al Pastor Taco SeasoningAl Pastor Taco Seasoning Heritage-Inspired At Siete, our Mexican-American heritage inspires everything we do. It's our way of honoring our heritage and sparking something new. Our heritage inspires all of our product innovation, making each product authentic to our Mexican-American hyphen—and distinctly Siete. Public Cinco EventPublic Cinco Event Solves Problems We want to create products that solve problems for our consumers. So, we make foods in a variety of delicious flavors, using thoughtfully selected ingredients, spanning a range of meals and snacks.

What Siete gains from the partnership Joining the PepsiCo family opens new doors for Siete. With access to PepsiCo’s retail and away-from-home (AFH) selling expertise and rich consumer insights, Siete can delight even more consumers across North America. This means new households discovering the brand for the first time and loyal fans finding Siete in more aisles, more stores, and more occasions. Importantly, the partnership is designed to preserve what makes Siete special: its culture, its values and its commitment to quality ingredients. Already, Siete’s strong performance shows what’s possible when authenticity is paired with commercial muscle.

A standout partnership with even more potential In January 2025, Siete Foods became the latest member of PepsiCo’s family of beloved brands — one as rich in culture as it is in flavor. This $1.2 billion acquisition brought in a company rooted in Mexican American family heritage and thoughtfully selected ingredients. It marked a significant milestone that will enable Siete to scale its mission, while advancing PepsiCo’s ongoing effort to offer consumers additional inclusive and culturally resonant food choices with ingredients consumers are seeking. But this partnership is about far more than adding another brand to PepsiCo’s portfolio.
